deed: צוות חילוץ ישראלי סרק את הריסות סרפסייד במשמרות של 12 שעות
title: Israeli rescue team searched the Surfside ruins in 12-hour shifts and helped locate the victims

trailer.text: The National Rescue Unit of the IDF Home Front Command, led by Col. (res.) Golan Vach, set out on Operation Helping Hand to help in recovery efforts following a building collapse in Surfside, Florida.
The 12-story Champlain Towers South collapsed in the middle of the night, as residents slept.
Many members of the local Jewish community were among those affected, and Israel pledged to help with the search and identification.
The Israeli team worked in two shifts of 12 hours and built three-dimensional models of the tower.

According to the IDF, as reported by the Algemeiner, the team located 81 missing people by the time it left the site on July 11, and the mayor of Miami-Dade County presented it with an honorary "key to the county," according to AP.

stations.title: A building that collapsed at night

paragraphs.text: The 12-story Champlain Towers South collapsed in the middle of the night, as residents slept.
According to the IDF Spokesperson, the 40-year-old building had 12 apartments on each floor and 196 residents, and because of the late hour most of them were at home.
Vach said the building collapsed unusually, from outside inward and in four parts, with one floor falling onto another.
According to him, this created a particularly challenging area for the rescuers.
Many members of the local Jewish community were among those affected.
According to AP, many of the families of the missing were Jewish.
According to the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), on June 24, 2021, Champlain Towers South, a 12-story residential building in Surfside, Florida, partially collapsed.
According to CBS Miami, the IDF sent the team after talks between Governor DeSantis, the Israeli Prime Minister and the Minister of Defense, and some Surfside residents requested it.
Florida Governor DeSantis said a small team was brought from Israel because many families of the missing wanted it.
Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett spoke with Governor DeSantis and instructed all government bodies to assist with any request.
Diaspora Affairs Minister Nachman Shai told DeSantis that Israel had brought its best people, carefully chosen and with relevant experience from past events.
Since the 1980s, Israel has sent 30 delegations from the IDF and Home Front Command to provide search-and-rescue aid in various countries.
Vach said the fact that America asked them to come was a great honor and privilege.
According to the IDF, the delegation, headed by Col. (res.) Golan Vach, consists of 10 reserve officers from the Home Front Command, all experts in engineering.
The delegation also included Foreign Ministry representative Guy Giladi, formerly Israel's deputy consul general in Miami.
According to Reuters, the National Rescue Unit arrived in Miami early on Sunday, three days after the building collapsed.
The IDF Spokesperson for international media said the team landed and went directly to the site.
According to AP, the Israeli team joined forces from around the United States and assisted the teams from Miami and Miami-Dade.
Together with the unit came a trauma and crisis team from United Hatzalah, an Israeli medical organization.
United Hatzalah sent six members of its trauma and crisis unit and a therapy dog to help the families and the community, not to search.

stations.title: The building rebuilt, on a computer

paragraphs.text: Vach said the teams studied the structure of the building while still in Israel and built three-dimensional models of the tower.
According to Algemeiner, the analysis team of Unit 9900 of the Intelligence Directorate, which specializes in visual intelligence, built a model that replicated the way the building collapsed.
According to AP, the team used blueprints of the building to create detailed three-dimensional images of the disaster site.
According to AP, the team gathered information from the families of the missing to build a room-by-room model of where people were sleeping at the time of the collapse.
According to a population officer in the Home Front Command, the team questioned the families to learn where each person was in the apartment.
Vach said the team was looking for the bedrooms, because people were sleeping.
According to JNS, the team generated 12-digit coordinates for the location of each room, with an estimated margin of error of one meter.
The IDF Spokesperson said with sadness that more bodies were found thanks to the mapping method.
Vach said everyone estimated it would take months to find the bodies, but now they were talking about days.
Vach said that since their arrival they had worked in two shifts of 12 hours each.
According to him, the Israelis spent every waking hour sifting through the debris or meeting with the families of the missing, with two- to three-hour breaks for sleep.
Half of the team met with the victims' families, while the other half searched relentlessly through the rubble.
According to Vach, the rescuers had to penetrate meters of concrete to reach the bedrooms and search for cavities where survivors may have been protected.
According to AP, the teams searched in intense summer heat and pouring rain, pausing only when lightning was spotted nearby.
Vach, who had by then commanded the unit for four years, said it was one of the most difficult and complicated situations he had seen.
At the end of each shift, team members met to talk and process the difficult task.
The commander of the Israeli team told the families that the team could search for every missing person and find each person in each apartment.
Surfside Mayor Burkett said the commander told the families without hesitation that the local rescuers were doing exactly the right thing.
Vach said the team had not given up hope, and that every day it finds new spaces and channels in the debris.
Elad Edri of the IDF delegation said that after the earthquake in Haiti they rescued someone after 108 hours, so there is still a chance.
Minister Shai was less optimistic, telling Channel 13 News that the chance of finding anyone alive was small.
Vach said the conversations with the families were difficult, and that the team was committed to being transparent with them as the chance of finding survivors grew slimmer.
According to The Media Line, local authorities announced on Wednesday that the objective of the search was no longer rescue but recovery of bodies.
According to AP, the pressure remained to find victims so families could bury their loved ones.
According to NBC Miami, the collapse killed 98 people, and a team from Israel led by Col. Golan Vach worked for two weeks on the rubble pile.
According to the IDF, as reported by the Algemeiner, the "Helping Hand" team located 81 missing people by the time it left the site on July 11.
Vach told The Palm Beach Post that he personally found 20 of the victims.

Vach found a plaque at the site with the name “Rabbi A.D. Davis,” and within 20 minutes the team located the rabbi, who was not in the building at the time; the rabbi said he had given the plaque to Brad Cohen, who lived in apartment 1110, and that is how Vach knew he was close to Cohen.
Vach said the meetings with the families, the photographs and the personal possessions helped him know who those found were.
Relatives of 54-year-old Estelle Hedaya confirmed that she had been identified as the 98th and final victim of the collapse.
According to AP, the mayor of Miami-Dade County thanked the team for their "unrelenting dedication" and presented it with an honorary "key to the county."
The Miami-Dade Fire Rescue chief recognized the Israeli team as honorary members of his department.
At the farewell, rescuers who had searched the site around the clock lined both sides of the street and shook hands with the Israeli team.
Vach said in 2023 that difficult incidents like Surfside add to resilience and give strength to face similar incidents.

disagreements.question: How many of the missing were Israelis or had ties to Israel?

versions.says: According to an Israeli official, more than two dozen of the 150 missing were Jewish and had links to Israel
According to The Media Line, 20 Israelis were among the missing

disagreements.question: How many people were in the Israeli delegation?

versions.says: According to the IDF, 10 reserve officers from the Home Front Command
According to an IDF statement, about 10 reserve officers and Foreign Ministry personnel
According to Algemeiner, another five officers joined in the following days, and the team included about 15 reserve officers
According to JNS, the delegation had 15 members, and according to the IDF Spokesperson seven more officers joined

disagreements.question: When did the Israeli team arrive at the site?

versions.says: According to The Media Line, by Friday an Israeli team was already at the site
According to Reuters and the Times of Israel, the team arrived on Sunday

disagreements.question: Which unit built the three-dimensional model?

versions.says: JNS wrote that an analysis team from the IDF Intelligence Directorate’s Unit 9990, which specializes in visual intelligence, built a three-dimensional map of the collapsed building, although in the same article the team’s commander is described as the commander of Team 9900.

disagreements.question: How long after the Haiti earthquake was a survivor found?

versions.says: Elad Edri said they rescued someone after 108 hours
According to the Miami Herald, the commander told the families the team found survivors a week after the earthquake
Vach told CBS Miami that in Haiti in 2010 he found a man alive, aged 64

disagreements.question: What was the Israeli team's share in locating and extracting the victims?

versions.says: The IDF, as reported by the Algemeiner: the team recovered 81 missing people by the time it left on July 11
Golan Vach to Israel National News: the Israeli team found most of the people who were located, but the extraction was done mainly by the American teams

claims.quote: Meeting up with the members of the families of the missing victims, studying their photographs and learning about their individual possessions

claims.text: קרובי משפחה של אסטל הדאיה בת ה-54 אישרו שזוהתה כקורבן ה-98 והאחרון של הקריסה.
claims.quote: On Monday, relatives of 54-year-old Estelle Hedaya confirmed that she had been identified as the 98th and final victim of the collapse.

claims.text: מפקד כבאות מיאמי-דייד הכיר בצוות הישראלי כחברי כבוד במחלקתו.
claims.quote: Miami-Dade Fire Rescue Chief Alan Cominsky honored the team as honorary members of his department.

claims.text: חברי כוחות החילוץ שחיפשו באתר מסביב לשעון עמדו משני צדי הרחוב ולחצו ידיים לצוות הישראלי בפרידה.
claims.quote: Members of the task forces that have been searching the site 24 hours a day since the June 24 collapse lined both sides of the street, shaking hands and bidding farewell to the Israeli team.

claims.text: וך אמר ב-2023 שאירועים קשים כמו סרפסייד מוסיפים לחוסן ונותנים כוח להתמודד עם אירועים דומים.
claims.quote: Horrible incidents like Surfside add something to our resilience, and it allows us, it gives us the strength to face similar incidents like these

claims.text: לפי גורם ישראלי, יותר משני תריסרים מתוך 150 הנעדרים היו יהודים בעלי קשרים לישראל.
claims.quote: More than two dozen of the 150 unaccounted for were Jewish and had links to Israel, according to an Israeli official.

claims.text: לפי The Media Line, היה ידוע שבין הנעדרים תושבים יהודים רבים, ובהם 20 ישראלים.
claims.quote: It was known that many Jewish residents, including 20 Israelis, were among the missing.

claims.text: המחלצים הישראלים הגיעו מצה"ל, כולל כ-10 קציני מילואים מפיקוד העורף ואנשי משרד החוץ, לפי הודעת צה"ל.
claims.quote: The Israeli rescuers come from the Israeli Defense Forces, the country's military, including about 10 reserve officers from the Home Front Command, along with Foreign Ministry personnel

claims.text: בימים שלאחר מכן הצטרפו למשלחת עוד חמישה קצינים.
claims.quote: Over the past few days, another five officers joined the delegation.

claims.text: לפי Algemeiner, הצוות כלל כ-15 קציני מילואים, מומחי הנדסה וטיפול חברתי.
claims.quote: The team included about 15 reserve officers who are top experts in engineering and social care.

claims.text: לפי JNS, המשלחת מנתה 15 חברים שסייעו לכוחות המגיבים בעזרת מיפוי תלת-ממדי ופעלו גם לתמיכה במשפחות הנעדרים.
claims.quote: Now, it is made up of 15 members, who are both helping first responders using the 3D mapping and conducting a humanitarian effort to support the families of the missing.

claims.text: לפי דובר צה"ל, שבעה קצינים נוספים הצטרפו לצוות.
claims.quote: Seven more officers then joined the team, he said.

claims.text: לפי The Media Line, עד יום שישי כבר היה צוות ישראלי באתר, ובחן את השכבות העליונות של ההריסות במשמרות של 12 שעות.
claims.quote: By Friday, an Israeli task force was onsite, sifting through the upper layers of rubble in 12-hour shifts.

claims.text: לפי Times of Israel, צוות מומחי חילוץ ישראלים הצטרף ביום ראשון לעובדים אמריקאים באתר הבניין שקרס חלקית ביום חמישי.
claims.quote: A team of Israeli search-and-rescue specialists joined American workers on Sunday at the site of a Florida apartment building that partially collapsed on Thursday

claims.text: JNS כתב שצוות ניתוח מיחידה 9990 באגף המודיעין של צה"ל, המתמחה במודיעין חזותי, בנה מפה תלת-ממדית של הבניין שקרס.
claims.quote: members of an analysis team from the IDF Intelligence Directorate’s Unit 9990, which specializes in visual intelligence, built a three-dimensional map of the collapsed building.

claims.text: לפי מיאמי הרלד, מפקד הצוות סיפר למשפחות שצוותו מצא ניצולים שבוע אחרי רעידת האדמה בהאיטי ב-2010.
claims.quote: the 10-member team’s commander told relatives his team found survivors a week after the deadly Haiti earthquake in 2010.

claims.text: וך אמר ל-CBS Miami שלפני עשור מצא בהאיטי ב-2010 אדם חי בנסיבות דומות, בן 64.
claims.quote: Ten years ago I found a man in similar circumstances alive in Haiti in 2010. We saved him, he was 64 years old,

claims.text: לפי המכון הלאומי לתקנים וטכנולוגיה של ארצות הברית (NIST), ב-24 ביוני 2021 קרס חלקית מגדל Champlain Towers South, בניין מגורים בן 12 קומות בסרפסייד שבפלורידה.
claims.quote: On June 24, 2021, Champlain Towers South, a 12-floor condominium in Surfside, Florida, partially collapsed

claims.text: צה"ל, כפי שדיווח Algemeiner: הצוות הוציא 81 נעדרים עד שעזב ב-11 ביולי
claims.quote: recovered 81 missing people by the time they left the Surfside site on July 11

claims.text: גולן וך ל-Israel National News: רוב הנעדרים אותרו בידי הצוות הישראלי, אבל החילוץ נעשה בעיקר בידי הצוותים האמריקאיים
claims.quote: the extraction of the missing people was done mainly by the American teams

claims.text: וך, שפיקד אז על היחידה זה ארבע שנים, אמר שזה אחד המצבים הקשים והמורכבים ביותר שראה.
claims.quote: Vach, who has commanded his unit for four years, said on Tuesday.
